metadata.title: Big Tech ETF climbs sharply as ‘Magnificent Seven’ stocks mostly rise - MarketWatch

content.text:
9 hours ago
Big Tech ETF climbs sharply as ‘Magnificent Seven’ stocks mostly rise
An exchange-traded fund that seeks to equally weight its portfolio of the megacap technology stocks known as the “Magnificent Seven” was up sharply Thursday, despite mixed trading among its holdings.
The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF — which holds Nvidia, Apple, Google parent Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon.com, Facebook parent Meta Platforms and Tesla — was gaining 1.6%. Nvidia easily had the biggest gains in stock price on Thursday, up more than 9%, while Tesla, Microsoft and Apple were also trading higher. By contrast, shares of Amazon, Meta and Alphabet were all down, according to FactSet data, at last check.
